process.title: How we take complex architecture from discovery to production handoff
process.subtitle: Each phase has explicit entry criteria, architectural decision records (ADRs), and verifiable production gates. You can expand multiple phases simultaneously to compare deliverables.

steps.title: Architecture Discovery & Baseline Telemetry Audit
steps.summary: We instrument your existing workloads, trace production bottlenecks, analyze cloud billing line-items, and map security boundaries before writing a single line of migration code.
deliverables: Prioritized Risk Register & Architecture Decision Records (ADRs)
Fixed-scope implementation roadmap with rollback milestones
steps.governanceNote: Gate 01: Executive & Principal Architect sign-off on target SLA metrics and budget ceiling.

steps.title: Foundation Blueprint & Infrastructure-as-Code
steps.summary: We provision isolated landing zones, modular Terraform/OpenTofu stacks, CI/CD pipelines, and automated security policy checks inside your version control system.
deliverables: Automated CI/CD pipelines with OPA security & compliance gates
OpenTelemetry collector mesh, Grafana dashboards & PagerDuty alert routing
Disaster recovery and automated backup verification scripts
steps.governanceNote: Gate 02: Automated penetration test & chaos failover drill in staging environment.

steps.title: Incremental Migration & Shadow Traffic Validation
steps.summary: Instead of high-risk "big bang" cutovers, we use strangler-fig routing and dual-write shadow traffic to validate performance, data parity, and latency under real production load.
deliverables: Automated data parity verifiers between legacy and target stores
Load testing benchmarks at 3x historical peak traffic
steps.governanceNote: Gate 03: 100% data reconciliation parity & p95 latency verification across 72 hours of live load.

steps.title: Operational Handover, Runbooks & Team Enablement
steps.summary: We ensure your internal engineering team has full ownership - conducting live game-day incident simulations, pair-programming sessions, and comprehensive documentation handoff.
deliverables: Recorded architecture walkthroughs & live SRE game-day drills
Complete removal of legacy decommissioned infrastructure
steps.governanceNote: Gate 04: Internal team independently executes deployment, rollback, and incident recovery drills.

faq.title: Common questions about engagement structure, security, and ownership
faq.subtitle: Clear answers regarding how our engineering teams integrate with your organization.

items.question: Who owns the infrastructure modules, scripts, and architectural code produced during an engagement?
items.answer: Your organization retains 100% intellectual property and source code ownership from day one. All code is committed directly to your private Git repositories under your license, with zero proprietary lock-in or recurring licensing fees to NovaTech.

items.question: How do you prevent service disruption when migrating live databases or legacy monoliths?
items.answer: We use change-data-capture (CDC) replication and dual-read/dual-write proxy layers so the new system processes shadow traffic alongside your legacy stack. Traffic is shifted in 1%, 10%, 50%, and 100% increments with instant automated rollback triggers if error budgets are exceeded.

items.question: How do your engineers handle access to regulated production environments (SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI-DSS)?
items.answer: We operate under strict least-privilege principles. Our engineers never store long-lived credentials; all work is performed through your federated SSO with short-lived bastion sessions, mandatory MFA, and full audit logging of every CLI command and pull request.

items.question: Do you replace our internal DevOps or platform team, or work alongside them?
items.answer: We work as a force multiplier alongside your internal engineers. Our goal is to eliminate your architectural backlog and build self-service tooling so your team can focus on core product features rather than firefighting infrastructure tickets.

items.question: How are engagements priced and scoped?
items.answer: Every project begins with a fixed-price 2-week Architecture Discovery audit. Following discovery, we provide a milestone-based fixed-scope proposal tied to verifiable engineering deliverables rather than open-ended hourly billing.
